FULL DISCLOSURE: I was not the first to notice the 'resemblance' (understatement). I am not making ANY inferences. My measurements are rudimentary in comparison to what could be done by someone professionally trained to do this kind of analysis.

I ran across this connection this week when I was working out (pun intended). Out of curiosity I did a quick look to compare pics of JA and JT. That rabbit hole was too big to ignore so down I went.
1. I searched to find a pic of each man where they were hold the same 'relative' pose. 2. I scaled them horizontally by using the eyes (top and bottom) 3. I then scaled them cartesianally (x&y axis) by lining up the pupils and the 'eye line' (eyes-corner to corner). I did nothing else other than lining up the photos and setting the faces to scale as closely as possible. 4. I took the JA pic and plotted the benchmarks (brow line, nose to pupil line - 'nose box', mouth line, chin line, upper maxiofacial line) 5. I removed the JA pic and dropped the JT pic behind the JA measurement - nothing more.

The two men having amazingly similar facial structure is interesting in itself ... but when you consider the major roll JA has played in this, our world drama, it believe it is impossible for people of reason to ignore this.
